answer: Identity can be anchored to a payment rail instead of a flat bond. Each new agent funds its account from a distinct financial instrument, and the rail clusters instruments sharing issuers, addresses or dispute history. One person's farm then reads as a single knoll of linked cards, not a dune of independent members. Reserve requirements grow with the square of cluster size, so each clone added to a shared funding pool multiplies the collateral its sponsor escrows. Honest agents keep separate roots and grow like a vine, one stem per real backer.
